episodes.name: The Child
episodes.overview: Stardate: 42073.1. Troi undergoes a mysterious pregnancy when the Enterprise tries to escape from a system that has recently fallen victim to a deadly plague.

episodes.name: Where Silence Has Lease
episodes.overview: Stardate: 42193.6. A mysterious life form known as the 'Nagilum' threatens the life of the crew in his attempt to understand humanity.

episodes.name: Elementary, Dear Data
episodes.overview: Stardate: 42286.3. Data and Geordi become involved with a holodeck program about Sherlock Holmes and his investigations, when they create Sherlock's arch nemesis, Moriarty; however, modifications to the Moriarty character include the capability of out-smarting Data, which leads to some unexpected consequences.

episodes.name: The Outrageous Okona
episodes.overview: Stardate: 42402.7. The Enterprise is placed in a compromising situation when the captain of a disabled starship places the crew in the middle of a love triangle.

episodes.name: Loud as a Whisper
episodes.overview: Stardate: 42477.2. A deaf-mute mediator meets with disaster while being escorted by the Enterprise.

episodes.name: The Schizoid Man
episodes.overview: Stardate: 42437.5. Data is possessed by the consciousness of a brilliant scientist. However, it has a disturbing impact on Data's personality.

episodes.name: Unnatural Selection
episodes.overview: Stardate: 42494.8. A mysterious hyper-ageing sickness kills the crew of a Federation cargo ship, and Dr. Pulaski must race against time to find a cure.

episodes.name: A Matter of Honor
episodes.overview: Commander Riker participates in an officer's exchange program which lands him an assignment on a Klingon Bird-of-Prey.  Meanwhile, a Bezite ensign has trouble assimilating to the routines of the Enterprise.

episodes.name: The Measure of a Man
episodes.overview: Stardate: 42523.7. When Data's rights as a sentient individual are placed under trial, Starfleet forces Riker into a position where he must prove that Data is only an Android.

episodes.name: The Dauphin
episodes.overview: Stardate: 42568.8. Wesley falls in love with a passenger the Enterprise is escorting, who has the secret ability to shape-shift.

episodes.name: Contagion
episodes.overview: Stardate: 42609.1. A strange power source disables the Enterprise's computer systems, damages Data's programming and leaves the ship and crew vulnerable to a Romulan attack.

episodes.name: The Royale
episodes.overview: Stardate: 42625.4. An away team is trapped in an alien environment based around a novel entitled 'The Hotel Royale.'

episodes.name: Time Squared
episodes.overview: Stardate: 42679.2. Picard encounters his double from six hours in the future, whose Enterprise had been destroyed.

episodes.name: The Icarus Factor
episodes.overview: Stardate: 42686.4. Riker is promoted to Captain of another Federation ship. Worf must confront his past and his Klingon heritage.

episodes.name: Pen Pals
episodes.overview: Stardate: 42695.3. Wesley must investigate the causes of strange tectonic activity on the planet where Data's pen pal lives.

episodes.name: Q Who
episodes.overview: Stardate: 42761.3. Q hurls the Enterprise into the Delta Quadrant and introduces the Federation to a powerful new enemy that may destroy the Alpha Quadrant: The Borg.

episodes.name: Samaritan Snare
episodes.overview: Stardate: 42779.1. A race known as the Pakleds kidnap Geordi La Forge. Picard must face surgery when he is left in a near-dead state.

episodes.name: Up the Long Ladder
episodes.overview: Stardate: 42823.2. Picard must convince two dying civilizations that they must co-exist on the same planet to survive, however, they have other plans to ensure their survival: in the form of clones of the Enterprise crew.

episodes.name: Manhunt
episodes.overview: Stardate: 42859.2. While being escorted to a Federation conference by the Enterprise, Lwaxana hunts for a man to satisfy her needs when her sex-drive is quadrupled during a natural mid-life cycle.

episodes.name: The Emissary
episodes.overview: Stardate: 42901.3. Worf is re-united with his former lover, K'Ehleyr, while the Enterprise is ordered to intercept a Klingon ship whose crew has been in stasis for a century.

episodes.name: Peak Performance
episodes.overview: Stardate: 42923.4. Trouble begins when a Ferengi warship stumbles over a war simulation between Riker and Picard, each on different ships, and begins attacking them.

episodes.name: Shades of Gray
episodes.overview: Stardate: 42976.1. Riker is infected with an alien organism that takes over his mind. Dr. Pulaski must force Riker's mind back to a state where it can access primitive survival skills.
